query:
UPDATE context_files
         SET path = CASE
                 WHEN path = $2 THEN $3
                 ELSE $3 || substring(path from char_length($2) + 1)
             END,
             version = version + 1,
             updated_at = NOW()
         WHERE channel_id = $1
           AND (path = $2 OR left(path, char_length($2) + 1) = $2 || '/')
